Official home page states '3 standard rooms, 3 underground cave rooms, 5 family & friends rooms and 6 suite rooms' and 'accommodating only 60 people at one time'.

detail: Added '36 rooms in all, mixing cave, fairy chimney and stone rooms' to the intro (EN + 5 translations). The official page gives no per-room cave/stone split, so none was added; existing text still says only some are carved into rock.

detail: Replaced 200 ft above the canyon floor with a cliff some 300 feet above the La Plata River valley in description, highlight and body (EN + 5 translations). Also changed 'Fruitland sandstone' to 'Ojo Alamo sandstone cliffs' per the official site, and removed 'natural stone floors' (the official amenities page says carpeted living room and bedroom).

Official site: cave 'built into the vertical cliffs'; the page's own description already said 'blasted'. Reworded the 'waterfall shower carved into the rock' amenity and body sentence to 'rock walls that incorporate a waterfall shower' per the official overview.

detail: Official amenities page lists a smart TV for streaming and no fireplace or DVD library. Replaced 'Television and DVD library' with 'Smart TV with streaming' and deleted the gas fireplace (amenity and body mention) in EN + 5 translations.

Car rental through the hotel is supported (kept, reworded); bike rental is only suggested as a way to explore, so removed. The restaurant was also not found on the page, but it was not flagged, so it was left in place; recommend re-checking it.

issue: Official site content retrieved only via a fetch tool summary; quote should be re-checked
detail: Re-checked via WebFetch: 'Melek Cave'deki her oda kayalardan oyulmuştur ve bireysel bir şekilde döşenmiştir' (every room is carved from rock and individually furnished). The page claim is supported. The fetch tool's summaries were the only access.

detail: Official site says 34 rooms and suites in cave and stone (rooms-suites and history pages). Replaced 30 with 34, and 'cave suites' with 'cave and stone rooms and suites' in description, highlights, meta, body (EN + 5 translations).

detail: Body now says the 34 rooms and suites mix cave and stone architecture, so not every unit is a cave; Deluxe Rooms are restored caves and The Konak Pool Suite is a detached stone house (official Imperial Pool Suites page).

issue: 'Highest point in Cappadocia' is unsupported
detail: The official FAQ says 'perched atop Uçhisar, the highest point in Cappadocia', so the claim is the hotel's own. Attributed it ('which the hotel describes as') in description and body, and deleted the unsupported 'views wider than anything else in the region' comparison (EN + 5 translations); dropped the claim from the DE/ES meta descriptions.

issue: Lil'a Restaurant 'consistently cited among Turkey's best' is an unsupported superlative
detail: Replaced with the official wording: selected by the Michelin Guide (attributed to the hotel), contemporary fine dining with a farm-to-table philosophy. Also removed the unsupported 'cave dining room with candlelight' and 'acclaimed cuisine' (Cavo is the cave wine cellar). Highlight reworded.

issue: Infinity pool 'carved into the rock' and spa 'carved into tufa' not confirmed

issue: Rating 9.6 and 1,243 reviews unsourced; founder's private collection claim not confirmed

Removed 'decades acquiring carpets, ceramics...' and 'oldest items several centuries old'.

issue: Page says the hotel is 'brand new'; the site's copyright is 2021, so the opening claim is dated
detail: Deleted the 'brand new / recent opening' sentence in EN + 5 translations. The site headline says 'A Brand New Luxury Hotel' but gives no opening date, so no replacement fact is available.

issue: Official site does not say the five cave rooms are rock-carved, only that they are 'caves'
detail: Replaced 'carved into the rock' with 'caves' in the intro (EN + 5 translations); the official site says 'five caves and three stone rooms'.

issue: Official site does not say which planet-named rooms are cave versus stone
detail: Added that the site does not say which rooms are the caves and which are stone, so ask when booking (EN + 5 translations).

issue: Room sizes stated as 30 to 40 sq m; official site also lists Eros and Agape at 50 sq m
detail: Official rooms pages show Eros and Agape at 50 m2. Updated the highlight to 30 to 50 sq m and added Eros and Agape to the rooms paragraph (EN + 5 translations).

issue: Official site does not state that rooms are rock-carved, only 'authentic cave rooms'; some Twin/Double rooms are not labelled cave
detail: Replaced 'The site presents the whole property as a cave hotel' with a statement that the site promises 'authentic cave rooms' while some twin and double rooms (e.g. Twin Room 107, 115) are not labelled cave, so ask when booking (EN + 5 translations). The page never said rock-carved.

issue: 'Hamam and Turkish bath' and 'pet-friendly' not confirmed in pages checked
detail: Official FAQ says 'Seki cave is a pet friendly hotel'; the Our Services page lists 'Cave Turkish Bath and Massage'. Both claims are supported, so no change.

issue: 'Eighteen interconnected cave chambers' and 'light shaft' details not confirmed; official says 18 rooms plus an ancient church

Deleted the light-shaft sentence. Replaced the nine-millennia remark with the official room list (a 30 m2 classic room and a 160 m2 executive suite with 7 m high walls).
